segments.name: Employer Services
segments.description: Serves businesses of all sizes worldwide with technology-based HCM solutions including cloud platforms and HR outsourcing services.
segments.evidence: Our Employer Services segment serves clients ranging from single-employee small businesses to large enterprises with tens of thousands of employees around the world, offering a comprehensive range of technology-based HCM solutions, including our strategic, cloud-based platforms, and HRO (other than PEO) solutions.

revenueModel.text: Employers pay for cloud-based HCM platforms, payroll processing, benefits administration, talent management, compliance solutions, and PEO co-employment services based on client size, number of employees managed, and service usage.
